items.title: Job’s three friends
items.charge: Speaking of God the thing that is not right; condemning the righteous, having found no answer

items.title: The nobles who exacted usury of their brethren
items.charge: Exacting usury every one of his brother; taking their lands, vineyards, oliveyards, and houses, and bringing their sons and daughters into bondage for debt

items.title: The returned exiles who married strange wives
items.charge: Not separating themselves from the people of the lands; taking their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy seed mingled itself with the people of those lands; the princes and rulers chief in the trespass

items.title: The two women before Solomon
items.charge: Two harlots, one living child, and a claim that only a sword could sort out

items.title: Zacchaeus
items.charge: Extortion as chief of the publicans
